Sub.: Outcome of the Board Meeting held on October 21, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/ Ma’am, 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30, 33 and other applicable provisions of Securities and Exchange Board 
of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (" Listing 
Regulations") read with circulars issued by SEBI (“SEBI Circular”), we wish to inform you that the 
board of directors of Eternal Limited (formerly known as Zomato Limited) (“ Board” and 
“Company”, respectively) at its meeting held today i.e. October 21, 2026, inter alia, has considered 
and approved: 
 
1. Unaudited financial results (standalone and consolidated) for the quarter and half year ended on 
September 30, 2026 (“Financial Results”). Further, the said results have been subjected to limited 
review by M/s Deloitte Haskins & Sells, statutory auditors of the Company. A copy of Financial 
Results, along with the limited review report issued by the statutory auditors, are enclosed. 
 
2. Business Transfer Agreement (“BTA”) between the Company and Zomato Entertainment Private 
Limited (“ ZEPL”), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, to transfer the Going-out India 
business housed in the Company, along with its respective assets and liabilities (collectively 
referred to as “Identified Business”) to ZEPL, by way of slump sale, on a going concern basis. The 
details as required under the Listing Regulations read with SEBI Circular is enclosed as 
Annexure – A. 
 
Subsequently, the Going-out India business housed in two other wholly owned subsidiaries of the 
Company - Orbgen Technologies Private Limited (“ OTPL”) and Wasteland Entertainment Private 
Limited (“ WEPL”), will also be consolidated into ZEPL. In order to enable this, the board of 
directors of ZEPL, OTPL and WEPL, have also granted in-principle approval at their respective 
board meetings held on October 21, 2026, to evaluate the means and manner of implementing the 
aforesaid business consolidation. 
 
The BTA and aforesaid consolidation is being undertaken as part of an overall internal 
restructuring exercise to consolidate the Going-out India business operating across various 
group entities, in a single wholly owned subsidiary - ZEPL to streamline the group’s corporate 
structure and achieve operational synergies. 
 
3. Sale of 11,214 (Eleven thousand two hundred fourteen) Series B compulsorily convertible 
preference shares and 10 (Ten) equity shares in Adonmo Private Limited (“ Adonmo”) to Vivish 
Technologies Private Limited (“Mygate”) and acquisition of 1,84,091 (One lakh eighty four thousand 
ninety one) Series C1 compulsorily convertible preference shares and 164 (One hundred sixty four) 
equity shares in Mygate.

The sale and acquisition of shares mentioned above is part of a single transaction (“Transaction”) 
wherein the Company will transfer all of its shares in Adonmo to Mygate in lieu of Mygate shares 
as consideration. 
 
The Transaction is a step towards a merger proposed to be executed by Adonmo and Mygate 
(“Proposed Merger”). Post completion of the Proposed Merger, all other shareholders of Adonmo 
will become shareholders of the merged Mygate entity and Adonmo will cease to exist as a 
separate entity. 
 
The Company will eventually own ~ 4.4% equity stake on a fully diluted basis in the merged Mygate 
entity. This stake is currently valued at INR 156 crore. The Company had invested INR 112 crore in 
Adonmo in January 2022. 
 
Adonmo is one of India’s leading ambient digital advertising platforms, operating a cloud-
connected network of screens across residential communities. Mygate is a technology platform 
focused on improving the living experience within residential gated communities by offering 
visitor management, security, accounting, and community engagement for residents. 
 
The Transaction is subject to execution of definitive agreements, fulfilment of certain customary 
closing conditions precedent and other terms and conditions under the transaction documents. 
The details as required in respect of sale and acquisition of shares, under the Listing Regulations 
read with SEBI Circular are enclosed as Annexure – B1 and Annexure - B2 respectively. 
 
The meeting of the Board commenced at 1:00 P.M. and concluded at 3:10 P.M. 
 
The above information will also be hosted on the website of the Company i.e.www.eternal.com.
